servers.description: Secure file system access with configurable allowed directories. The official MCP filesystem server — read, write, edit, list, and search files within allowed paths. Best choice for most file operations.
tools: read_file — 读取单个文件完整内容
write_file — 创建或覆盖写入文件
edit_file — 基于行范围的精确文件编辑
list_allowed_directories — 列出允许访问的目录

servers.description: Repository management, file operations, and GitHub API integration. Create/update issues, PRs, branches, search repos, manage files. Requires GitHub personal access token.
tools: create_or_update_file — 创建或更新仓库文件
search_repositories — 搜索 GitHub 仓库
get_issue — 获取 Issue 详情

servers.description: Read-only database access with schema inspection and query capabilities. Connect to PostgreSQL databases, explore table schemas, and run read-only SQL queries. Requires DATABASE_URL env var.
tools: query — 执行只读 SQL 查询
describe_table — 查看表结构（列名、类型、约束）

servers.description: Browser automation for web scraping, screenshots, and interaction. Navigate pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and execute JavaScript in a real Chrome browser.
tools: screenshot — 截取页面或元素截图
evaluate — 在页面中执行 JavaScript

servers.description: Web and local search using Brave's Search API. Perform web searches and local place/business searches. Requires a Brave Search API key (free tier available).
tools: brave_web_search — 网页搜索，返回标题+URL+摘要
brave_local_search — 本地商家/地点搜索

servers.description: Persistent memory system using a knowledge graph. Stores entities and relationships, enabling the AI to remember and reason about past interactions across sessions.
tools: create_entities — 创建知识图谱实体节点
create_relations — 创建实体间关系边
open_nodes — 查看实体及其关联关系
read_graph — 读取整个知识图谱
delete_observations — 删除实体上的观察记录

servers.description: Slack workspace integration for channels and messaging. Send messages, list channels, search history, manage users. Requires Slack Bot Token with appropriate scopes.
tools: slack_post_message — 发送消息到频道/用户
slack_get_channel_history — 获取频道消息历史

servers.description: Dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thought sequences. Enables the AI to break down complex problems into sequential steps, revise earlier thoughts, and explore branches — useful for math, logic, and planning.
tools: sequentialthinking — 多步推理思维链（可分支、回溯、修正）

servers.description: Google Maps geocoding, directions, and places search. Geocode addresses, calculate routes, search nearby places. Requires Google Maps API key.
tools: maps_search_places — 地点搜索（类型+半径）
maps_place_details — 获取地点详细信息
maps_distance_matrix — 多点距离/时间矩阵
maps_directions — 路线规划（驾车/步行/公交）

servers.description: Fast file search on Windows using Everything SDK. Provides instant filename search across all drives. Requires Everything (voidtools.com) to be installed and running.
tools: search — 按文件名搜索（支持通配符），比 Windows 自带搜索快百倍

servers.description: Sentry error tracking and performance monitoring integration. Query Sentry issues, events, and project stats. Requires Sentry Auth Token.
tools: get_issue — 获取单个 Issue 详情
get_event — 获取错误事件详情

servers.description: SQLite database interaction and business intelligence. Run SQL queries, explore schema, and analyze local SQLite databases. Great for data analysis and prototyping.
tools: read_query — 执行 SELECT 查询

servers.description: Google Drive file access and search. List, read, and search files in Google Drive. Requires Google Drive API credentials.
tools: search — 按文件名/类型搜索 Drive 文件
read_file — 读取文件内容（Google Docs→Markdown）

servers.description: Time and timezone conversion. Get current time in any timezone and convert between timezones. Pure Python, no API key required.
tools: get_current_time — 获取指定时区当前时间

servers.description: Web content fetching and conversion to markdown. Fetches URLs and intelligently converts HTML to clean Markdown text for the AI to process. Pure Python, no API key required.
tools: fetch — 抓取网页并转为 Markdown（支持自定义 User-Agent）

servers.description: Git repository operations directly from AI. View diffs, read commit logs, manage branches, and stage changes. Operates on a specific git repo path. Pure Python, no API key required.
tools: git_branch — 分支列表/创建/切换
git_show — 查看某次提交详情
